name: thoughtknot
description: Draw the graphs written in notes, and edit them by typing or by dragging the drawing.

scripts.build: npm run build --workspace packages/graph-spec && npm run build --workspace packages/obsidian && npm run build --workspace packages/claude-code
scripts.typecheck: tsc -p packages/core --noEmit && tsc -p packages/core/src/display --noEmit && tsc -p packages/obsidian --noEmit && tsc -p packages/graph-spec --noEmit && tsc -p packages/claude-code --noEmit && tsc -p packages/claude-code/page --noEmit
scripts.test:ai:py: node scripts/run-ceiling.mjs uv run --locked --directory python/graph_spec python ../../scripts/quiet_unittest.py
